title: Lucky Numbers — Luxury Kinetic Oracle
risk_reason: Lucky Numbers adds a complete interactive daily mode with Canvas animation, persistence, localized interpretation, synthesized SFX/haptics and Save/Share. The PWA Service Worker/cache identity also moves to V0.9.0. Protected tarot-selection subsystems remain unchanged.

feature_contract.selection: created only on deliberate reveal start; crypto.getRandomValues where available with rejection sampling
feature_contract.persistence: same device-local day restores the exact fixed set; interruption cannot reroll; replay is presentation-only
feature_contract.framing: symbolic daily reflection and play; not lottery, gambling, investment or guaranteed outcomes
feature_contract.presentation: responsive Canvas/CSS brass-and-crystal kinetic oracle with three-ball sequential reveal
feature_contract.accessibility: reduced-motion path, localized canvas labels and DOM result text
feature_contract.export: localized Save/Share portrait artwork using shared reading-export utility

protected: Ask Ganesha question semantics and persistence
Three-Card / Golden Path / Remove the Obstacle Focus daily locks

rollback.instruction: Restore the V0.8.1 runtime/build/cache files from this commit and remove V0.9.0 Lucky Numbers files if a serious regression appears.
